name: Diurnal-Quoin
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, ancient meteor crater. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
For traders, aluminum, iron, uranium and platinum alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
